learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the power of unity! Learn the court dimensions, rules, and skills of major team sports like Basketball and Volleyball.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Played by two teams of 5 players on a rectangular court. The objective is to shoot the ball through the opponent's hoop. Key skills include dribbling, passing, shooting, and rebounding.
You cannot run while holding the ball (Traveling foul) and cannot dribble with two hands at once (Double Dribble). Matches are usually divided into four quarters.
Played by two teams of 6 players separated by a net. The goal is to ground the ball on the opponent's side. Key skills include serving, passing (bump), setting, and spiking.
Players must rotate clockwise one position every time their team wins the serve back from the opposition. A team can only touch the ball 3 times before sending it over the net.
In team sports, a single star player cannot win alone. Success relies on communication, understanding roles, trust, and executing coordinated strategies.

fun_activity.title: 🏀 The Wall Pass
fun_activity.instructions: Stand 3 meters away from a wall. Practice the 'Chest Pass' by pushing a basketball (or any bouncy ball) against the wall and catching it. See how many clean passes you can do in 30 seconds!

exam_tips: 📌 Memorize standard court sizes: Basketball (28m x 15m) and Volleyball (18m x 9m).
📌 Know the different points in basketball: Free throw (1 pt), Field goal (2 pts), Beyond the arc (3 pts).
📌 Clearly define 'Rotation' in Volleyball and the maximum touches allowed (3).
quick_recap: ⭐ Basketball was invented by Dr. James Naismith using peach baskets.
⭐ In volleyball, the 'Libero' is a specialized defensive player wearing a different colored jersey.
⭐ Good defense is just as important as good offense in team sports.
